title: UAF Green Bikes

services.name: Green Bikes
services.desc: Students, employees, and the public can come in to use the tools and resources available in the shop (a fee is charged for parts) on their own bike. All basic hand tools are ready for use, including specialty tools such as crank puller, tube patch kit, spoke wrench, etc. We do not repair personal bikes, but have student mechanics on hand to teach you how to do basic repairs and maintenance yourself. Keep your eye out for information on Green Bikes group rides, unicycle hangouts, movie nights, workshops, sales and more! All events are posted in Nanook Engage. All UAF students are eligible for low cost semester-long rentals. Students and the public have access to short term and specialty
